Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LOMBOK REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2017

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF NORTH LOMBOK,

Considering a.

that to realize the constitutional rights of every citizen in accordance with the principle of equality before the law, the Regional Government needs to endeavor to guarantee the protection of human rights for Women and Children;

b. that Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, thus requiring optimal Protection;

c. that Protection as referred to in letter b is included in mandatory affairs which are the duties, authority and responsibility of the Regional Government and its prevention must involve all parties;

d. that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a, b, and c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation and Protection of Women and Children.

In View of

1.

Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia;

2.

Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1999 Number 165, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3886);

3.

Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2002 Number 109, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4235) as amended by Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 297, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5606);

4.

Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 95, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4419);

5.

Law Number 26 of 2008 concerning the Establishment of North Lombok Regency in West Nusa Tenggara Province (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2008 Number 99, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4872);

6.

Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 244, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015 concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2015 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5679);

7.

Government Regulation Number 4 of 2006 concerning the Implementation and Cooperation for Recovery of Victims of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2006 Number 15, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5121);

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 29

P2TP2A as referred to in Article 28 letter a functions as a coordinating institution among the Regional Government, law enforcement officials, service institutions, educational institutions, Legal Aid institutions, Individuals, Private entities and/or NGOs, which have capacity in the Protection of Women and Children.

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 27

The procedures and procedures for the Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence are further regulated by Regent Regulation.

CHAPTER IV

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILD VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

Paragraph 1

Prevention and Protection

Article 35

The Regent is obliged to carry out guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: conducting technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

CHAPTER III

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 18

Legal aid services are intended to provide Assistance and Protection for Women and Child victims of Violence with a gender-responsive approach so that victims and perpetrators obtain justice and certainty of their legal rights.

(2) Types of legal aid services include:

a. litigation legal aid; and
b. non-litigation legal aid.
(3) The Regional Government organizes legal aid in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations.
(4) In providing legal aid as referred to in paragraph (3) the Regional Government cooperates with advocate organizations in the Region.

Article 12

The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to facilitate efforts for the Protection, promotion, enforcement and fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children in accordance with its authority based on the provisions of laws and regulations.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 27

The procedures and procedures for the Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence are further regulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 29

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children shall be carried out with due regard to religion, customs, social culture of the Community by prioritizing the basic principles of Women's rights and Children's rights.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

Article 27

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 29

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

CHAPTER III

Part Two

Implementation of Protection of Women and Children

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children shall be carried out with due regard to religion, customs, social culture of the Community by prioritizing the basic principles of Women's rights and Children's rights.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

Article 12

The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to facilitate efforts for the Protection, promotion, enforcement and fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children in accordance with its authority based on the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 5

The Regional Government, Community, family, and parents have obligations and responsibilities for efforts in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

Article 29

P2TP2A as referred to in Article 28 letter a functions as a coordinating institution among the Regional Government, law enforcement officials, service institutions, educational institutions, Legal Aid institutions, Individuals, Private entities and/or NGOs, which have capacity in the Protection of Women and Children.

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Paragraph 2

Article 27

The procedures and procedures for the Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence are further regulated by Regent Regulation.

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 29

P2TP2A as referred to in Article 28 letter a functions as a coordinating institution among the Regional Government, law enforcement officials, service institutions, educational institutions, Legal Aid institutions, Individuals, Private entities and/or NGOs, which have capacity in the Protection of Women and Children.

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 15

(1) Every person must protect Women and Children from the threat of danger of Violence against Women and Children.

(2) Every person or Institution is prohibited from falsifying data/documents that result in Violence against Women and Children and/or the non-fulfillment of Children's rights.

Article 25

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Part Two

Implementation of Protection of Women and Children

5.3.text:
Article 30

In order to increase the effectiveness of the Implementation of Child Protection, the Regent forms the LPA as referred to in Article 28 letter b which is independent in nature.

The LPA as referred to in paragraph (1) has the duty to: conduct Supervision of the implementation of Protection and fulfillment of Children's rights;

provide input and proposals in the formulation of policies regarding the Implementation of Child Protection; collect data and information regarding Child Protection; receive and conduct examination of community complaints regarding violations of Children's rights; conduct mediation on disputes regarding violations of Children's rights; conduct cooperation with community institutions, Government and NGOs in the form of work networks, for the fulfillment and Protection of Children's rights; and conduct handling activities on cases of violations and neglect of Children's rights.

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 35

The Regent is obliged to carry out guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: conducting technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children shall be carried out with due regard to religion, customs, social culture of the Community by prioritizing the basic principles of Women's rights and Children's rights.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

Article 29

P2TP2A as referred to in Article 28 letter a functions as a coordinating institution among the Regional Government, law enforcement officials, service institutions, educational institutions, Legal Aid institutions, Individuals, Private entities and/or NGOs, which have capacity in the Protection of Women and Children.

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.

Article 30

In order to increase the effectiveness of the Implementation of Child Protection, the Regent forms the LPA as referred to in Article 28 letter b which is independent in nature.

The LPA as referred to in paragraph (1) has the duty to: conduct Supervision of the implementation of Protection and fulfillment of Children's rights;

provide input and proposals in the formulation of policies regarding the Implementation of Child Protection; collect data and information regarding Child Protection; receive and conduct examination of community complaints regarding violations of Children's rights; conduct mediation on disputes regarding violations of Children's rights; conduct cooperation with community institutions, Government and NGOs in the form of work networks, for the fulfillment and Protection of Children's rights; and conduct handling activities on cases of violations and neglect of Children's rights.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

CHAPTER IV

Article 35

The Regent is obliged to carry out guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: conducting technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

The provision of facilities and infrastructure as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b, is for the fulfillment of service standards; The provision of facilities and infrastructure by the Regional Government shall be carried out gradually adjusted to the financial capacity of the Region.

Protection of Women and Children shall be carried out with due regard to religion, customs, social culture of the Community by prioritizing the basic principles of Women's rights and Children's rights.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children is a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship to Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and mistreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the Child.

The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate Services so that minimum Services for victims of Violence are needed. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to carry out the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Children Victims of Violence, particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.

ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children shall be carried out with due regard to religion, customs, social culture of the Community by prioritizing the basic principles of Women's rights and Children's rights.

The basic principles of Protection of Women's and Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (1) include: non-discrimination; best interests of Women and Children; right to life, survival, and development; respect for the views of the Child; legal certainty (Protection of victims' rights); local wisdom; justice and gender equality; transparency; accountability; and sustainability.

c. that Protection as referred to in letter b is included in mandatory affairs which are the duties, authority and responsibility of the Regional Government and its prevention must involve all parties;

d. that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a, b, and c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation and Protection of Women and Children.

IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 3

The Implementation of Protection of Women and Children aims to: provide guidance to the Regency Government in planning policies and strategies for Protection of Women and Children; prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children and violations of Women's and Children's rights; protect and provide services to Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; strengthen the protective environment for Women and Children from all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment and neglect; enhance empowerment of Women and Children; and enhance the role of government Institutions, business entities, media and/or NGOs in the Region.

CHAPTER IV

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILD VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

Article 31

(1) The community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.

(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:

a. assisting the Regional Government in the form of Protection Supervision of the Implementation of the Protection of Women and Children;
b. reporting to the competent authorities if they know of Women and Children experiencing Violence; and
c. participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

Part Two

Implementation of Protection of Women and Children

Article 35

The Regent is obliged to carry out guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: conducting technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.

Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

Article 7

The Community has obligations and responsibilities for the Protection of Women and Children through Community participation activities in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in the form of: providing information and/or reporting every occurrence of vulnerability risk and Violence that comes to their knowledge; facilitating deliberation and consensus to create restorative justice for Children in conflict with the law through informal channels and carried out at the village/sub-district government level and institutional authorities; identifying/early detection and initial handling of Children at risk; mediation and guidance for families experiencing domestic Violence, household conflicts, and divorce; preparation of families and the Community in receiving Children who are victims of mistreatment and/or Children at risk; and the process of repatriation, social Rehabilitation, and social Reintegration.

Article 12

The Regional Government has the obligation and responsibility to facilitate efforts for the Protection, promotion, enforcement and fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children in accordance with its authority based on the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 15

(1) Every person must protect Women and Children from the threat of danger of Violence against Women and Children.

(2) Every person or Institution is prohibited from falsifying data/documents that result in Violence against Women and Children and/or the non-fulfillment of Children's rights.

Article 9

Every Woman and Child has basic rights as a human being that must be protected, promoted, upheld and fulfilled in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 27

The procedures and procedures for the Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence are further regulated by Regent Regulation.

STRENGTHENING AND DEVELOPMENT OF SERVICE PROVIDER INSTITUTIONS FOR THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

Article 6

The Regional Government has obligations and responsibilities to: respect and guarantee the human rights of every Woman and Child without distinction as to ethnicity, religion, race, class, sex, ethnicity, culture, and language, legal status of the Child, birth order of the Child, and physical and/or mental condition; provide support for facilities and infrastructure in the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children, including providing breastfeeding places for Children, playgrounds, recreational places, Protection houses, as well as establishing integrated service centers for Protection of Women and Children; supervise the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; ensure the availability of a safe and comfortable environment for optimal growth and development of Children; allocate budget to Institutions that have programs in the field of Protection of Women and Children; coordinate programs, budgets and services that ensure ease of service to victims; formulate guidelines for the implementation of Protection of Women and Children; provide services for Women and Children who are Victims of Violence; monitor, supervise and evaluate the Implementation of Protection and Assistance for Women and Children; prevent, reduce risks, and carry out handling of all forms of Violence, exploitation, mistreatment, Children in conflict with the law and Children in emergency situations; strengthen Child care based on family and Community; increase the participation of Children in making policies that affect them, including in family life, education and Community; and increase Community participation in the Protection of Women and Children including prevention, risk reduction and handling.

Article 18

Legal aid services are intended to provide Assistance and Protection for Women and Child victims of Violence with a gender-responsive approach so that victims and perpetrators obtain justice and certainty of their legal rights.

(2) Types of legal aid services include:

a. litigation legal aid; and
b. non-litigation legal aid.
(3) The Regional Government organizes legal aid in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations.
(4) In providing legal aid as referred to in paragraph (3) the Regional Government cooperates with advocate organizations in the Region.

Article 29

P2TP2A as referred to in Article 28 letter a functions as a coordinating institution among the Regional Government, law enforcement officials, service institutions, educational institutions, Legal Aid institutions, Individuals, Private entities and/or NGOs, which have capacity in the Protection of Women and Children.

The duties of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) include:

a. providing Services, including: preparing and developing information related to Women and Children as well as coordinating to all Regencies and reporting to the Province/Province of West Nusa Tenggara; developing a central database obtained from the Region regarding the condition of Violence against Women and Children; receiving complaints both in writing and orally; conducting Services, mediation and Accompaniment for victims of Violence against Women and Children; conducting education/training; and coordinating with related institutions/individuals both in other Regencies/Cities, Provincial Government in the framework of providing Protection for Women and Children.
b. providing Protection to victims of acts of Violence, reporters and witnesses.
(3) The appointment of P2TP2A management as referred to in paragraph (1) is stipulated by Regent Decree.
(4) P2TP2A is under the coordination of the SKPD or work unit that handles the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.

Article 42

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
